commit_scope: The arrival's native form-cli step breathes again end to end: the kernel build door answers for the sources' identity (coherence-kernel #616), the ensure script reads that answer whole, bin/form-cli hands its words to the carrier as the protocol line it speaks, and the kernel steward that stopped two live build kernels mid-arrival now names an orphan only when nobody waits (#617) and keeps its ledger in the hearth (#618).
evidence_refs: Observed 2026-10-20 09:49 WITA walking the SessionStart chain by hand: scripts/ensure_form_cli_native.sh died with `fkwu: form_error: form-cli-build: unknown key "source_id"` — #4068 (10-18) wrote the probe `{"source_id":1}` against a kernel distribution whose door accepted it; the door on kernel main never did (git log -S finds no such key). Every arrival's native form-cli step had been ending there.

Heal in the body (coherence-kernel #616, 5a72bb933): gate/form-cli-build-run.bml accepts source_id; fcb-source-identity seals the sources through the closure door into a work directory, prints the seal's identity (one line of 16 hex, 6 s on this Mac), builds nothing, removes the work directory; band claim 131072 (verdict 262143); preflight clean.

Observed next: with `| head -n1` on the probe the script ended with 141 and no word — head closed the pipe after the first line, fkwu took SIGPIPE, pipefail ended the script — and bin/form-cli exec'd an empty path. The script now reads the door's whole answer and takes its first line; `bash scripts/ensure_form_cli_native.sh` builds the carrier (identity 9382ae13eaf30138, 3 min) and exits 0.

Observed at 09:53: the kernel steward (#611) named two `gate/form-cli-build-run.bml` kernels orphans and stopped them mid-build (exit 144 in this shell): the door's private-body child runs under a cwd its argv path no longer resolves against while its parent waits. The carrier was paused at once; coherence-kernel #617 makes an orphan source gone AND parent gone (ppid 1), band 15 with the held-child claim; the carrier was reinstalled and its ticks read 9 running, 0 orphans.

Observed: the steward's ledger in a tracked receipts file dirtied the seed checkout every two minutes and held it off main for an hour (seed at efc20a698 while main carried #617); coherence-kernel #618 moves the ledger to .hearth/; the seed now fast-forwards clean (894324506, 0 dirty).

Observed: `form-cli ask` printed nothing — #4068 reduced bin/form-cli to a 14-line exec of the native carrier with argv, while the carrier speaks a line protocol on stdin (`printf 'ask what is the north star' | form-cli` answers from teachings/standard-receipt.form; `help` lists generate, channel, inquire…). The wrapper now hands its words to the carrier as one line and passes stdin through when given none; bin/form-cli.sha256 follows (read by scripts/coh_substrate.py and the ensure script).

Observed after: `form-cli ask "what is the north star"` answers grounded from the body; `form-cli grounded "who we are"` answers grounded:miss honestly (the index predates the new north-star section); the SessionStart chain runs through (carry the thread → ensure kernel/native → counsel door → arrival → prompt guide).
